description: This file defines React components and hooks related to contextual actions for relationship fields within a KeystoneJS admin interface, including menu rendering, action handling, and link generation for related items.

methods.name: ContextualActions
methods.description: Main React component that combines children and menu for relationship field actions.

methods.name: ContextualActionsMenu
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering the action menu with options to add or view related items.

methods.name: useRelatedItemLabel
methods.description: Hook determining the label for related item links based on field configuration.

methods.name: useRelatedItemHref
methods.description: Hook generating URLs for related items depending on the relationship value.

methods.name: buildQueryForRelationshipFieldWithForeignField
methods.description: Function constructing query string for relationship filtering based on foreign field and local ID.
